text.tspan: L2 = WELLNESS on the existing slab (x −1.80…22.20, y 24.10…30.10, do not core). Same zoning as REV E (balcony on the court side, treatment rooms on the
north), re-planned for the new S1 stair and with the old west core/lift removed.
ARRIVAL: S1 floor landing +3.50 (x 1.74…3.20) → glass door in the north wall → reception. Other ways in: west-wing bridge at the west end of the balcony,
east door to the +3.50 landing / catwalk +4.50. S1 continues up to L3 in the same footprint.
WET ROOMS ON THE NORTH WALL ONLY (WC, rinse shower, cold plunge, sauna): drains run on the slab inside a 150 mm raised floor and leave through the north
façade into external downpipes → buried drains behind grid 5 at GF. No coring.
LOADS: 2 HBOT chambers and the cold plunge sit next to the grid-5 columns (row y 28.10); design live load ≤ 300 kg/m² to be checked by the structural engineer
NO LIFT: L2/L3 are not wheelchair-accessible. If needed later, an external lift can go back at the old position (x −3.80…−1.80) beside the balcony west
